stories.title: Lula wins fourth term as Brazil's president, defeating Flavio Bolsonaro
stories.line: Lula won Brazil's presidential runoff against Flavio Bolsonaro, starting a fourth term facing a hostile Congress.

stories.title: Taxes due tomorrow: how to request a filing extension
stories.line: Federal tax returns are due tomorrow, and filers who need more time can request an extension.

stories.title: Daily Mail names NHS doctors it says voiced antisemitic views
stories.line: A Daily Mail investigation names NHS medics it says have expressed antisemitic views, raising questions about their conduct toward patients and colleagues.

stories.title: Anthropic-linked AI bot reached Georgia public voter data hub
stories.line: An AI bot tied to Anthropic reportedly accessed Georgia public voter data, raising questions about election data security.

stories.title: Musician Ketch Secor calls on country artists to break silence on gun debate
stories.line: Country musician Ketch Secor is urging fellow artists to speak out on gun violence after the Nashville school shooting, despite fears of fan backlash.

stories.title: Israel tightens West Bank crossings and raids Hebron ahead of elections
stories.line: Israel is tightening West Bank crossings and raiding Hebron before its elections while Iran war strikes remain on hold.

stories.title: Venezuelan opposition leader María Corina Machado returns home after months in exile
stories.line: Venezuelan opposition leader María Corina Machado has returned home after months in exile.

stories.title: Trump escalates anti-Muslim attacks on Michigan Democrat El-Sayed at rally
stories.line: Trump used an anti-Muslim attack on Democratic candidate El-Sayed at a Michigan rally to rally the Republican base.

stories.title: Eastleigh collapse exposes repeated City Hall enforcement failures in Nairobi
stories.line: A Nairobi building collapse has exposed a pattern of ignored warnings, enforcement failures and irregular approvals at City Hall, with police now hunting the developer and contractor.

stories.title: Storm Boelo kills two, cuts power to 160,000 in UK and Europe
stories.line: Storm Boelo killed two and left over 150,000 homes without power across northern Europe, with another storm, Chloe, forecast next.
